headline: Global oil prices top $88 a barrel after Trump vows retaliation for surprise Iranian attack on U.S. troops
detail: Geopolitical tensions are driving oil prices significantly higher. This can fuel inflation concerns, potentially leading to higher interest rates or a more hawkish Fed stance. Higher inflation and rates are generally negative for growth-oriented tech and chip stocks, especially for a margin-heavy portfolio.
rec: Consider tightening stops or trimming positions in highly concentrated tech/chip holdings like QQQ, SMH, SOXL if oil continues to climb, as this could pressure your book.
